scenario.summary: UAT-6275 (also known as TAG-193) targets government entities in the CIS region using diverse infection vectors including macro-enabled documents, PowerShell downloaders, and a WinRAR path traversal exploit (CVE-2025-8088). The campaign deploys custom reverse shells such as PickleShell, Chvost, and Laplas, securing long-term access through Scheduled Tasks and Windows Startup folder persistence.

hunt.name: UAT-6275 FortiWeb Edge Appliance Exposure
hunt.description: This hunt examines the organization's external attack surface for vulnerable Fortinet appliances targeted by UAT-6275. The hunt first identifies systems reporting CVE-2025-25257 and maps them to hostnames. An analyst then uses these hostnames to focus behavioral queries on incoming HTTP requests containing SQL injection patterns and anomalous outbound network connections. An agent evaluates these disparate signals to determine if a vulnerable appliance has been successfully compromised.

config.content: SELECT f.resource_uid, d.hostname AS device_hostname, f.cve_uid, f.severity FROM hb_vulnerability_finding f JOIN hb_devices d ON f.device_uid = d.device_uid WHERE f.cve_uid = '{{target_cve}}' AND f.status != 'suppressed'
config.description: Find all systems currently reporting the target CVE and retrieve their hostnames for scoping.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames reporting the CVE. Silence proves no systems are currently flagged with this vulnerability in the scanner.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, url_query, src_endpoint_ip, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_query) LIKE '%select%' OR LOWER(url_query) LIKE '%union%' OR LOWER(url_query) LIKE '%sleep(%' OR url_query LIKE '%''%' OR url_query LIKE '%--%' OR url_query LIKE '%/*%') AND status_code IN (200, 500) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify inbound HTTP requests containing SQL injection markers targeting appliances in scope.
config.expected_signal: Requests with SQL keywords or non-alphanumeric markers that resulted in successful processing or server errors. Silence suggests the WAF or appliance blocked the attempts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) as conn_count, MIN(time) as first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND dst_endpoint_port NOT IN (80, 443, 53, 514, 541) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port
config.description: Find outbound network connections from scoped appliances to non-standard ports, signaling potential reverse shell activity.
config.expected_signal: Connections to rare external IPs or high ports, excluding standard management and monitoring ports. Outbound traffic to non-standard ports is the primary indicator of a shell.
